presenceCondition: (and (= MARLIN_H true) (= PIDTEMP true) (= PID_DEBUG false))
model:
(define-fun PID_DEBUG () Bool
  false)
(define-fun MARLIN_H () Bool
  true)
(define-fun PIDTEMP () Bool
  true)
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: Same file as PRODUCT_54/89/104/105/119 (8c4377dd635.c, Marlin manage_heater). Dead store on 'pid_output' at line 13. When MARLIN_H=true, PIDTEMP=true, PID_DEBUG=false: the #if PIDTEMP && PID_DEBUG block containing SERIAL_ECHO_START (the known WrongFunArgNum vbdb bug) is NOT compiled because PID_DEBUG=false.
